definition: each chain as the closed surface that holds its own volume (0.135 nm³ for each amino acid, 0.32 nm³ for each nucleotide) in a cloud where each residue is spread as a Gaussian 1.3 nm wide, on a grid 1.3 nm apart (coarser than the setting's 1 nm, to hold the budget); of a surface in pieces, its largest and every piece of at least 5% of its volume are kept, smaller ones dropped (listed under dropped)
illustration: The viewer's own surface of the entry's coordinates, an illustration: not the structure, and nothing of the entry is copied but the numbers worked out here. The Protein Data Bank states no surface.
title: High resolution Cryo-EM structure of human complex I in mitochondria
frame: the measuring tool's frame: origin at the centre of the whole's atoms; y from the part MT-ND1's centre to the part NDUFV1's; x the whole's longest axis made square to y; z = x × y
